parts.title: The Spark
parts.closing_line: The wind rose. The fleet sailed. And Clytemnestra, back in Mycenae, began to wait — while across the sea, a war that was supposed to be quick settled in for ten long years.

parts.title: The Cost of Glory
sections: CHAPTER 6: A DUEL AND A GOODBYE
parts.closing_line: The spear went through his neck. Achilles tied the body behind his chariot and dragged it around Patroclus's tomb every morning, for twelve days.
parts.tease_card: NEXT: A KING WALKS INTO HIS ENEMY'S TENT

parts.title: Prophecies and the Horse
sections: CHAPTER 8: THE KING IN THE TENT
parts.closing_line: The Trojans pulled the horse inside. They celebrated all night, and then they slept — unaware that the war had finally crossed their own threshold.

parts.title: Fire, Homecoming, Evidence
parts.closing_line: In the Greek version, it all began with a guest list. A party, and one goddess nobody thought to invite.
